annotations.title: List homes found for a property watch

description: Use this when the user asks what LivinIsto has found for an intent created with intent_publish_intent. These are the same homes LivinIsto e-mails to the user; this server cannot send messages into the conversation by itself. Requires the intentCode; optional since (ISO time) returns only newer matches. Returns at most 20 newest matches with the asking price and LivinIsto price verdict at the time of the match and a link. Before the user confirms the intent there are no matches. Matches come from listings LivinIsto aggregates from the market, so they cover only homes listed on LivinIsto and may be incomplete; a home may already be sold or rented.

since.description: Only matches found after this ISO time.

name: intent_list_matches

location.description: Municipality and part as stated in the listing.

name.description: Property type and layout in Czech, e.g. "Byt 2+kk" or "Rodinný dům".

priceCzk.description: Asking price today in CZK (monthly for rent). null = the listing states no real price for the whole property — see priceNote; never present any number for it.

priceCzkAtMatch.description: Asking price when LivinIsto matched it.

priceNote.description: Why no price is shown, in Czech.

propertyType.description: byt (flat), dum (house), chata (cottage), pozemek (building plot), apartman.

roomOnly.description: A room in a shared flat, not the whole flat.

url.description: Link to the listing on www.livinisto.cz — show it unchanged.

more.description: More matches exist than returned; call again with since.

status.description: awaiting_consent = the user has not confirmed on the LivinIsto page yet; awaiting_email_confirmation = the user filled in the page and must click the link in the e-mail; active = LivinIsto is watching; expired = the confirmation link, the buy-by date or the intent's validity ran out; withdrawn = cancelled.

title: List homes found for a property watch
